conventions.engine: patch_lib.run_patched: map-aware fork of l0/stage2/lib/genome.py run_genome (IMEX-FFT dt=0.02 dx=0.5); spatially-varying D = min-base implicit FFT + conservative explicit div(dD grad f)
conventions.grid: N=192 px, dx=0.5 -> L=96 length-units; ALL user-facing distances in px (1 unit = 2 px)
conventions.rho: rho_B(x)=0.5*(tanh((x-x_lo)/w)+tanh((x_hi-x)/w)); band [48,144)px -> seams at 48 and 144 px; w quoted in px (w_len=w_px*dx); 10-90% ramp = 2.2w
conventions.blend: theta(x) = theta_A + rho_B*(theta_B-theta_A) per param; maps only for params that differ
conventions.worlds: A=ref_M0 (A=tau*Dv=3, static blob); B=ref_M4(tau) A=4 family (tau=5.8 traveling single, single onset 5.748); non-aligned vacua via k1_orig shift
conventions.seeding: M0 static: G.poke u-bump amp2 sig3; M4 traveler: A4 stamp paste, kick=(angle,kick_px) v,w displaced opposite (composite convention)
conventions.metrics: tracking = genome.py Tracker (periodic label, circ-mean centroid, greedy identity); positions unwrapped, reported in px

checklist_score.penetrate: YES — traveler crosses the seam at all w in {4,12,24} lu (t_cross 222/300/950); no rebound, no death, no split (ncomp==2 throughout with static ctrl)
checklist_score.pin: no (no stall AT the seam; motion continuous through it)
checklist_score.one_way_block: ASYMMETRIC by construction: A-side is a static world (M0), nothing can travel toward the seam from A; kicked A-side seed coasts 0.9 lu and stalls (w4_in)
checklist_score.refraction: YES (oblique 45deg-from-normal run, w=12): tangential speed component dies as the blob decelerates through the ramp — exit trajectory is bent to NORMAL incidence (0.0 deg): the seam collimates like glass->dense-medium refraction at grazing-exit limit; y advance total 6.7 lu
checklist_score.seam_localized_state: no (blob does not stay at the seam: it is dragged THROUGH into A)

mechanism: two facts: (1) traveler penetrates because its own momentum/wake carries it through the sub-onset ramp (tau_eff(seam)=4.40 < onset — it cannot TRAVEL there, but crossing takes only ~100-300 tu, faster than the drift-mode decay); (2) after crossing it is NOT free: the rho-gradient exerts a body force. P6 fresh-static probe: v ~ -0.37..-0.46 * drho/dx (lu/tu) — statics are EXPELLED from the seam into the patch interior with force ∝ weight gradient, range = full ramp (2.2w). At w=12 the creep persists to x~2-4 lu (rho_B~0.02).
creep_is_seam_force: P6: fresh static blobs placed at d=4/8/13/20 lu show the same creep with NO crossing history (v_mid -0.0140/-0.0108/-0.0071/-0.0021): the post-crossing creep is a static PoU-seam force, not momentum memory
taupatch_control: P7: with Dv GLOBAL (wiring-only tau seam, A_A=3.0), traveler decelerates on the ramp, xmin=26.25 (does NOT cross 24), then is pushed BACK +x and parks at 8.7 lu standoff INSIDE B: tau-only seams REPEL/park travelers instead of swallowing them; the crossing in the main P2 is powered by the Dv-blend (dD flux term + shallower A_eff dip along the (tau,Dv) chord)
geometry_note: main P2 blends BOTH tau and Dv (M0 native vs M4(5.8) native): chord passes A_eff=tau_eff*Dv_eff ~ 3.7 at seam mid; taupatch chord passes A_eff=3.0->4.0 linearly with Dv fixed

settle: PASS both widths: no nucleation (ncomp 0 throughout), background settles to a smooth u0(x) ramp within ~1 lu of the naive rho-blend prediction (max dev 0.0021 at w=8px=4lu, 0.0007 at w=24px=12lu); initial RHS max 1.25e-3 == controller's predicted ~2e-3 scale (chord residual 1.25e-3 + Du lap u0 1.1e-3)
blob_drift: blobs near a vacuum-mismatch seam are EXPELLED toward the shallow-vacuum (A) side and keep drifting to the patch-A interior: x0=16: w=4 parks at x~11 (v→-7e-4); w=12 still drifting at x=2 after 2500 tu (v -0.0019); no along-seam drift observed (dy=0.00; straight normal expulsion — controller's 'drift along seams' NOT seen at this mismatch: the force is normal, not tangential)
existence_trap: C1: the k1_orig=-0.8 endpoint world does NOT support blobs at all (poke dies, T=600); C2 chord: s=0.5 lives, s=1.0 dies — the P3 'seam' is really a blob-existence CLIFF: a blob at x0=40 lu (rho_B=0.92, k1_eff~-0.79) simply DIES (ncomp 0 at first record). P0 pre-flight MUST include endpoint + chord blob-existence pokes, not just vacuum stability
verdict: non-aligned vacua are safe at this mismatch (no seam nucleation, smooth ramp) but the seam acts as a FENCE with a one-sided force pushing blobs into the shallow-vacuum world; combined with the existence cliff, k1-mismatch seams partition the world into 'habitable A / lethal B' with a soft repulsive shoulder

halo_penetration: w-halo crosses the seam unattenuated-in-kind: |w| decay length 2.6 lu across the seam into B (vs 1.35 lu near-blob A-side; bare-channel sqrt(Dw*theta)=3.74); at the seam |w|=9.3e-3, at 12 lu past it 4.4e-5. The seam itself carries NO static structure in aligned-vacuum patches (far-field devs <1e-6: eta(x,y)-clean, exactly the controller's vacuum-safe-wiring claim)
response: sep 28 lu across seam: NO response (A and B blobs settle identically to lone controls, net disp <0.02 lu). sep 20 lu: REAL mutual repulsion — A pushed -1.30 lu, B pushed +1.60 lu vs +0.04 control, still separating at t=2000 (|v|~5e-4)
calibration: same-world M4(4.0) pair at sep 20 (P7_pair20): repels 20->23.5 by t=2000 — the cross-seam repulsion at 20 lu is the SAME tail physics as in-world (outside d*=15.4 well, inside first repulsive ring); seam neither screens nor creates the interaction
verdict: cross-world interaction exists and is ordinary tail/halo physics passing through the seam; interaction range (~20-28 lu boundary) matches in-world; long-range w leak is real but weak (halo at 20 lu past seam ~1e-5-level)

ctrl: uniform M4(4.0): pair at 15.4 locks at 15.40, sep_std 0 — textbook
cross_w24: M0|M4(4.0) w=24px(12lu... NOTE w_lu=24 was logged for mode=cross): bond SURVIVES straddling the seam, d* shifts 15.40->15.26 (-0.9%), pair center pushed +0.05 lu; both blobs alive 2500 tu
cross_w4: narrow seam w=4 lu: bond survives but the PAIR is expelled as a unit into patch A (centers 16.6/31.9 -> 11.9/27.4, i.e. -4.7 lu shift; d* wobbles 15.15-15.53, std500 0.034): the seam force (P6) acts on the whole molecule; bond persists while sliding
m0_side_check: C3: pure-M0 pair at 15.4 holds ~15.2-15.5 over 2500 tu (drifting slowly; M0 A=3 bond well is weak/marginal) — the straddling bond is genuinely bridging a strong-well world and a weak-well world
verdict: chemistry survives seams: d* shift <1% at wide seam; narrow seams do not break the bond but transport the whole molecule down the rho-gradient
